# World History Encyclopedia

> > A comprehensive encyclopedia covering ancient civilizations including Greece, Egypt, Rome, and Mesopotamia with articles, images, and timelines.

World History Encyclopedia provides scholarly articles, archaeological evidence, historical timelines, and visual resources documenting ancient civilizations, their cultures, religions, warfare, daily life, and contributions to human history. Content spans from prehistoric burial practices to the Hellenistic Period, featuring detailed entries on cities, artifacts, literature, and historical figures.

## Key Topics

- Ancient Greece
- Ancient Egypt
- Ancient Rome
- Mesopotamia
- Hellenistic Period
- Bronze Age
- Athens
- Archaeological sites
- Ancient writing systems
- Burial practices and tombs
- Wars of the Diadochi
- Silk Road trade
- Greek colonies
- Egyptian agriculture
- Ancient literature

## Ancient Greek Civilization

- [Hellenistic Period](https://www.worldhistory.org/Hellenistic_Period): Hellenistic Period after Alexander's conquests and Greek expansion
- [Syracuse](https://www.worldhistory.org/syracuse): Greek colony Syracuse on Sicily founded by Corinth in 734 BCE
- [The Pythia – Priestess of Ancient Delphi](https://www.worldhistory.org/article/205/the-pythia---priestess-of-ancient-delphi): Oracle Pythia priestess at Delphi's Apollo temple and prophecy rituals
- [Trebizond](https://www.worldhistory.org/Trapezus): Greek colony Trapezus (Trebizond) on Black Sea, modern Trabzon
- [Kykeon](https://www.worldhistory.org/Kykeon): Ancient Greek barley beverage used in Eleusinian Mysteries rituals
- [Agora of Athens](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/192/agora-of-athens): Map of Athenian Agora in 5th century BCE showing key buildings
- [Heraclitus of Ephesos](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/592/heraclitus-of-ephesos): 17th century painting of philosopher Heraclitus by Johannes Moreelse

## Ancient Egyptian Culture

- [Plowing Egyptian Farmer](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/112/plowing-egyptian-farmer): Burial chamber art of Sennedjem showing Egyptian plowing c. 1200 BCE
- [Timeline: Egyptian Faience](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/Egyptian_Faience): Timeline of Egyptian faience glassmaking techniques and production

## Ancient Rome and Military History

- [The Battle of Lake Trasimene](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/166/the-battle-of-lake-trasimene): Hannibal's ambush of Flaminius at Lake Trasimene during Punic Wars
- [Domus Romana](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/105/domus-romana): Cut-away illustration of typical Roman domus residential architecture
- [The Limes in Germany](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/241/the-limes-in-germany): Map of Roman limes fortifications near Trier, Germany

## Ancient Writing and Literature

- [Literature](https://www.worldhistory.org/literature): Origins of literature in ancient Mesopotamia and Sumerian writing
- [Cuneiform Writing](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/93/cuneiform-writing): Assyrian cuneiform relief from British Museum London collection

## Archaeological Sites and Artifacts

- [The Stonehenge Burials](https://www.worldhistory.org/article/206/the-stonehenge-burials): Prehistoric cremation cemetery at Stonehenge, Wiltshire, England
- [Godin Tepe](https://www.worldhistory.org/Godin_Tepe): Archaeological site Godin Tepe in Kangavar valley, western Iran
- [Venus of Milo](https://www.worldhistory.org/image/111/venus-of-milo): Hellenistic Aphrodite statue from Melos at Louvre Paris collection

## Historical Timelines and Reference

- [Timeline: Antigonus I](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/Antigonus_I): Timeline of Antigonus I Monophthalmus, Alexander's successor
- [Timeline: Sogdiana](https://www.worldhistory.org/timeline/sogdiana): Timeline of Sogdiana in Central Asia along Silk Road trade routes
- [Tomb](https://www.worldhistory.org/tomb): Ancient burial practices and tomb structures across civilizations
